about.title: About the game
about.body: Unlock Numbers is a calm logic puzzle: free every number from the stone grid by pairing twins and tens in the receiving slots.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Your progress, coins and settings are stored only on this device. The game collects no personal data. When ads and purchases go live, they will be handled by Google and Apple under their own policies.
support.title: Support & help
support.body: Questions, ideas or a puzzle that stumped you? We would love to hear from you.
install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add Unlock Numbers to your home screen to play full screen — even offline.
install.manual: Use your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
guide.title: How to play
guide.pick.title: Pick a glowing tile
guide.pick.body: Only open tiles can be picked. At the start, the whole bottom row is open.
guide.unlock.title: Follow the arrows
guide.unlock.body: Taking a tile opens only the locked tiles its arrows point at. A star opens nothing.
guide.fixed.title: Nothing moves
guide.fixed.body: A taken tile leaves an empty space. Nothing falls, slides or refills.
guide.slots.title: Five slots
guide.slots.body: Picked tiles wait in five slots, in the order you picked them. Only tiles side by side can match — plan so partners meet.
guide.chain.title: Chains
guide.chain.body: When a match frees space, the waiting tiles close ranks and may match again.
guide.win.title: Win and lose
guide.win.body: Clear the board and the slots to win. If every slot fills up with no match, the level is lost.
guide.boosters.title: Three boosters
guide.boosters.body: Sixth slot: one extra slot for the level. Hint: shows the best tile to take. Swap: exchange two waiting tiles, once.
guide.modes.title: Levels and Challenge
guide.modes.body: Levels are fixed puzzles that never change. Challenge forges a new puzzle every time and grows harder as you win.
rule.pair_equal.title: Twins vanish
rule.pair_equal.body: Two equal numbers side by side in the slots disappear. Colours don’t matter.
rule.pair_sum10.title: Ten vanishes
rule.pair_sum10.body: Two neighbours that add up to 10 disappear: 1+9, 2+8, 3+7, 4+6 and 5+5.
rule.triple_sum10_distinct.title: Three of a kind of ten
rule.triple_sum10_distinct.body: Three neighbours of three different colours that add up to 10 disappear.
endless.scoring: Each board is worth more than the last. Perfect picks keep its full value, other picks and help lower it, and a lost board ends the run.
